tests.description: The single-repository path: the first add, the first check, a wrong root, and the usage error when nothing is declared.

steps.description: The first add, previewed: --dry-run prints the entry it would splice into the page's frontmatter and writes nothing.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni cite add test/fixtures/cite/pages/no-citations.md:6 src/limits.ts:2 --id fetch-timeout --no-config --root test/fixtures/cite --dry-run

steps.description: The report names both pins and the file line the claim sits on after the write, which is ten lines below the line that was typed.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni cite add test/fixtures/cite/pages/no-citations.md:6 src/limits.ts:2 --id fetch-timeout --no-config --root test/fixtures/cite --dry-run
runShell.stdio: /added fetch-timeout to frontmatter \(claim at line 16, sha256-921b21cc…; source src\/limits\.ts:2 "export const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;", sha256-78af1d33…/

steps.description: The first check: both ends hash to their pins, both read in file lines, and the summary is green.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:15 current\s+src\/limits\.ts:2 current[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: A root that does not hold the source reports missing rather than resolving to the wrong file, and exits 1.
A declared collection makes a bare check cover the right pages: this repository's own config checks its own docs with no arguments.
No positional paths and no config is an operational error, exit 2, not a silently empty pass.

runShell.stdio: No files to check. Pass paths/globs, or declare a collection under `collections:` in manni.config.yaml.
